We design and produce crystal chandeliers, marble wall sconces, pendant lights and project fixtures for buyers in Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and the Americas — backed by CCC and ISO 9000 certified quality and over a decade of export manufacturing.

PROJECT_CASES.heading: Project cases
PROJECT_CASES.note: A look at how our lighting is being used — hotel lobbies, boutique retail, exhibition builds and residential interiors. Every project below was designed and produced in our Zhongshan workshop.

cases.title: Geometric loop ceiling lighting
cases.caption: Interlocking loop lines that read as one continuous light line from every angle.

detail.client: Fitness club & wellness studio — project reference
overview: The same geometric loop system, installed in two different fitness environments — a high-floor city gym and a garden-facing wellness studio. The curved LED lines are arranged in an interlocking ring-and-arc composition, so the ceiling reads as a single continuous light line from every angle in the room.
Because the pattern is modular, it scales from a single feature bay to an entire floor of the facility: both installations use the same fixture family, adjusted only for ceiling height and span.
specs: Extruded aluminum profiles, LED line, powder-coated frame

cases.title: Hexagon grid ceiling system
cases.caption: A modular honeycomb light field that scales from one panel to an entire corridor.

detail.client: Airport lounge & corporate office — project reference
overview: A hexagon grid ceiling system installed in two settings: an airport lounge overlooking the apron, and a long office corridor with full-height glazing. Black extruded frame modules carry white LED edges that form the honeycomb pattern, with the spacing tuned to the ceiling structure in each space.
The modular grid scales from a single feature panel to a full ceiling field. Warm accent lines along the perimeter tie the pattern to the joinery and keep long runs of the grid from reading cold.
specs: Black anodized aluminum, LED edge modules

cases.title: Interlocking ring cluster chandelier
cases.caption: Black-framed LED rings hung in a staggered cluster — one sculptural piece, two rooms.

detail.client: Corporate lobby & boutique retail — project reference
overview: One interlocking ring cluster, two rooms: a light stone corporate lobby and a dark, metallic boutique retail space. The black-framed LED rings are hung at staggered heights, which gives the piece its depth and makes it look different on approach from each side of the room.

The cluster works at two scales — a single statement grouping over a reception or sales floor, or a larger multi-unit field for higher ceilings. Frame color and ring diameter are matched to the interior during the design stage.
specs: Black steel frame, LED ring, stainless cables

cases.title: Vortex LED tube chandelier
cases.caption: A spiral field of warm LED tubes, suspended from a circular opening above.

detail.client: Hotel atrium & art museum — project reference
overview: The vortex chandelier hangs from a circular opening in the ceiling — first in a double-height hotel atrium, then in a museum rotunda. Hundreds of warm LED tubes are suspended on fine cables in a loose spiral, so the installation reads as a slow current of light rather than a solid form.

The same system was scaled between the two spaces: the hotel version fills a wider atrium opening, while the museum version is pulled tighter and lower to sit with the gallery below. Cable spacing and tube length are set per ceiling height.
specs: Warm LED tubes, stainless steel cables, brass ceiling plate
